chapter: Tenor sax and the Austin boys
title: Ashcraft's own high school bands at New Trier and Senn
summary: Ashcraft describes the school bands he played in around 1922-23 and the Dartmouth musicians who worked Chicago summers.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: No, I don't think so. I associate Bud, for some reason or other, with Bud Jacobson, with the South Side. And he may have been the University High, too. I'm just not certain about that. Now, there were high school bands at San High School on the Near North Side. And at New Trier in Winnetka. And when I first met, but never really got to know the Austin boys, it must have been in 22 and 3. When I was playing with the first band organized around New Trier and then later San.

Nobody of any consequence. I think the only one that was known afterwards at all was Chug Champlin, who played a whole lot of different instruments. Phil Thompson, who played the banjo. Abbie Barker. Well, as a matter of fact, many of them, because Chicago is quite a Dartmouth town, went to Dartmouth and were part of the Dartmouth-Barberi Coast.
And then they would come back and often take jobs in summer in Chicago.
